body:
Founder real-time: 'the SSO should be sticky when i click around it forgets im logged in'. New shared js/iduna-sso.js loaded by both store.html and friends.html, replacing each page's own separate, page-local session storage. Each page's handleSsoReturn() now checks a fresh SSO redirect return first, then falls back to a shared session from an earlier page visit -- friends.html silently re-exchanges the shared session for a fresh DEADWEIGHT token on every load. logout() on either page clears the shared session too. Deployed live and verified: js/iduna-sso.js reachable, both pages reference it. WOTAN b4a9f66.

⚓ ☃
title: SSO session is now sticky across WOTAN pages
